title: Secure the one-time Astral Plane transition rewards
summary: Defeat the attacking githyanki, loot Prelate Lir'i'c for the Boots of Uninhibited Kushigo, and finish the Astral Prism decision before the portal closes.
avoid: Do not leave the transition encounter before looting the prelate; this Astral Plane visit cannot be revisited from Rivington.
why: The boots are a core Open Hand Monk item and this is their only acquisition window.
completionChecks: Boots of Uninhibited Kushigo obtained or deliberately missed

source.label: BG3 Wiki - Boots of Uninhibited Kushigo

title: Stabilize Rivington before crossing north
area: Refugee district and Circus of the Last Days
summary: Meet Yenna, inspect Arfur's basement, visit the Gur and Ironhands, audit the circus, and help the Strange Ox before entering the Lower City.
avoid: Do not enter the Lower City while the Strange Ox delivery or desired Rivington contacts remain unresolved.
why: Rivington provides safer XP, vendors, companion leads, and two transitions that close when the party moves farther into the city.
completionChecks: Strange Ox carried into the city or deliberately declined

title: Solve the Open Hand Temple murders
area: Open Hand Temple and Fraygo's Flophouse
summary: Investigate Lorgan, clear the temple tunnels, recover the murder evidence and flower key, then report to Valeria.
avoid: After reading the murder list, do not approach a listed Lower City target unless ready to intervene before resting.
why: This opens the murder investigation, Lower City access, and the safe route to Orin's Netherstone.
completionChecks: Murder list and flower key obtained

source.label: BG3 Wiki - Open Hand Temple murders

title: Save Geraldus, then attend the coronation peacefully
area: Danthelon's Dancing Axe and Wyrm's Rock
summary: Visit Jaheira's Harper contact before entering the Lower City, then hear Gortash's bargain without starting a fight and speak with Mizora afterward.
avoid: Do not attack Gortash in an audience hall containing nine Steel Watchers, and do not skip the coronation if Ravengard is to be rescued.
why: This preserves Geraldus, moves Ravengard to the Iron Throne, and keeps the safest main-quest sequence available.

decision.prompt: How should Gortash's proposed alliance be handled?

recommended.label: Accept it temporarily
costs: The alliance ends when the Iron Throne is entered

alternatives.label: Attack at the coronation
costs: Nine Steel Watchers and many allies join

title: Resolve Lower City deadlines before routine exploration
area: Basilisk Gate, Wine Festival, Gazette, and Wyrm's Rock prison
summary: Free Florrick once her notice is read, resolve Stop the Presses in its activation day, save Cora, speak with Devella before resting, stop Dolor at Figaro, and save Volo when approached.
avoid: Do not start a one-rest deadline and then continue unrelated exploration.
why: Act 3 has few global clocks, but these trigger-based deadlines permanently remove NPCs or outcomes.

incident.trigger: A deadline has been activated by an execution notice, Ettvard, the murder list near Cora, or the Cora rescue.
safeActions: Complete the triggered rescue before the next long rest
incident.never: Assume every Act 3 quest is harmless to postpone after its local trigger.
incident.escape: Finish the active deadline immediately; Orin's kidnapped victim is not on a long-rest clock.
incident.honorDelta: The mechanics are unchanged, but a missed clock cannot be recovered in a single-save run.
postFight: Confirm the rescued NPC and journal state before resting

title: Recruit Minsc and reach level 12
area: Guildhall, Counting House, and Abandoned Cistern
summary: Follow Jaheira's Stone Lord trail through the Guild and Counting House, then knock Minsc out with a non-lethal melee strike after every other hostile is down.
avoid: Do not use ranged, spell, surface, or rider damage for the final hit on Minsc.
why: Minsc adds a companion and ally while this quest line supplies enough controlled XP to approach level 12.

title: Use controlled side quests to reach level 12
area: Sorcerous Sundries, Old Garlow's Place, and Philgrave's Mansion
summary: Resolve only the side stories and rewards the run needs: Lorroakan, Vanra and Ethel with Hag's Bane, Mystic Carrion after destroying his organs, and remaining vendor audits.
avoid: Do not fight Ethel before preparing Hag's Bane if saving Vanra, and do not fight Carrion while his heart remains intact.
why: The major companion and Chosen encounters are safer at the level cap; this phase is a deliberate XP bridge, not a requirement to clear every quest.
completionChecks: Party reached level 12 or remaining XP plan accepted
Hag and Carrion prerequisites prepared before combat
Desired vendors and permanent rewards reviewed

riskReward.reward: Level 12, companion outcomes, allies, and endgame equipment.
riskReward.risk: Optional bosses can consume resources or close branches when entered unprepared.
riskReward.skipCost: Lose only the skipped stories, rewards, and XP.

title: Defeat Cazador and resolve Astarion's ritual
summary: Apply sunlight, keep away from ledges, free Astarion immediately, deny ritual sources, and then resolve ascension and the prisoners deliberately.
avoid: Do not leave Astarion trapped for three turns or let Vampiric Swarm line up a lethal push.
why: This completes Astarion's story, secures Rhapsody, and can add final-battle allies.

decision.prompt: Should Astarion complete the Rite of Profane Ascension?

title: Defeat Viconia without surrendering Shadowheart
summary: Spread before dialogue, control the stair approaches, counter darkness, avoid radiant retaliation, and resolve Shadowheart's parents afterward.
avoid: Do not surrender Shadowheart or open with radiant area damage into Radiant Retort.
why: This completes Shadowheart's story while preserving her as a companion.

title: Raid the House of Hope and defeat Raphael
summary: Enter in disguise, obtain the boudoir password, take the Hammer or contract and desired artifacts, free Hope, restore at the faucets, then break Soul Pillars to reduce Raphael's legendary-action charges during the escape fight.
avoid: Do not raise the alarm before the archive plan is ready, and do not begin the escape without restoring resources.
why: The Orphic Hammer enables the Orpheus ending route and the House contains several endgame items.
rewards: Gloves of Soul Catching if Hope survives

title: Pass the Murder Tribunal and defeat Sarevok
summary: Use the murder evidence or deception to enter, separate Sarevok from the Echoes, trigger Murderous Retort with a durable unit, and focus him first.
avoid: Do not kill the Echoes first; their deaths grant Sarevok permanent buffs.
why: The Amulet of Bhaal is required to reach Orin, and Sarevok's records improve the hostage route.

decision.prompt: How should the Tribunal be infiltrated?

recommended.label: Deceive them, then kill Sarevok
benefits: Preserves Valeria and the good route
costs: Requires dialogue success or murder evidence

alternatives.label: Become an Unholy Assassin
benefits: Unlocks the Bhaalist trader and armour
costs: Incompatible with the reviewed good route

title: Rescue the hostage and defeat Orin
summary: Resolve and free the hostage, bait Sanguine Lash with a durable nearby attacker, satisfy Bhaal's Edict if it appears, strip Unstoppable with multi-hit attacks, then burst Orin.
avoid: Do not rely on shove tactics near the arena edge or treat the Dark Urge duel as the normal party encounter.
why: Orin's Netherstone is mandatory and defeating her first satisfies the safest temporary Gortash bargain route.
completionChecks: Hostage alive, unchained, and safely returned from the temple

dependencies.reason: Defeat Sarevok and recover the Amulet of Bhaal before entering Orin's temple.

title: Rescue the Iron Throne before touching the Foundry
summary: Assign each rescuer a corridor before docking, use mobility immediately, shoot cell levers from range, save Ravengard and Omeluum where present, and return everyone by turn five.
avoid: Do not enter without a rehearsed five-turn movement plan, and never destroy the Foundry first.
why: This preserves Ravengard, Omeluum, and Gondian hostages while weakening Gortash's political and industrial control.
completionChecks: All party members returned before collapse

dependencies.reason: Defeat Orin before breaking the temporary Gortash alliance at the Iron Throne.

incident.trigger: The submersible docks and the five-turn Honor countdown begins.
safeActions: Dash, Fly, and teleport on turn one
Use Omeluum's teleport to return a rescuer
incident.never: Spend early turns looting or fighting enemies that do not block a rescue lane.
incident.escape: Abandon optional loot and prisoners that cannot still reach the ladder; every party member must board before turn five ends.
incident.honorDelta: Honor allows five turns, matching Tactician and one fewer than Balanced.
postFight: Confirm each intended prisoner is physically aboard

title: Disable the Steel Watch and Hellfire Titan
summary: Protect Gondians, disable every Motivator immediately, keep Toobin alive, then remove the Titan's Bulwark with Flashblinders before destroying the Neurocitor.
avoid: Do not leave a Motivator active or remain beside a Watcher that has started self-detonating.
why: Disabling the Steel Watch removes the largest threat from the final Gortash assault.

dependencies.reason: Complete the Iron Throne rescue before destroying the Foundry.

source.label: BG3 Wiki - Steel Watcher Titan combat

title: Defeat Ansur with a reserved final-phase plan
summary: Use a lightning-resistant unit or summon to draw Draconic Wrath, protect the party from Stormheart Nova, then remove the 100 temporary HP from Unrelenting Storm's Honor-only final phase.
avoid: Do not spend every defensive resource before the first lethal hit; it triggers another nova rather than ending the fight.
why: Ansur completes Wyll's city story and provides two defining martial rewards.

title: Defeat Gortash after the Steel Watch falls
summary: Return after Orin, the Iron Throne, and Foundry are resolved; clear traps and Banites methodically, remove Tyrant's Curse immediately, and recover the Netherstone.
avoid: Do not fight while the Steel Watch is active or remain inside overlapping grenade and force-curtain zones.
why: Gortash's Netherstone completes the required set of three and his death unlocks the final approach.

dependencies.reason: Recover Orin's Netherstone before ending the temporary Gortash route.
Disable the Steel Watch before assaulting Gortash's office.

title: Pass the Morphic Pool lockout audit
summary: Finish every desired quest, choose the final four, move all endgame equipment and quest items from camp, and distribute restoration consumables before touching the skiff. Save elixirs and Until Long Rest buffs for after the forced Astral Prism rest.
avoid: Do not use the skiff until party composition, inventory, Orphic Hammer, all three Netherstones, allies, respecs, and camp storage are final; do not waste endgame elixirs before the forced rest.
why: The skiff is Act 3's event horizon: camp, storage, party swaps, Withers, respecs, and ordinary long rests are gone afterward.
completionChecks: All optional route steps completed or deliberately skipped
Consumables and gear moved from camp

dependencies.reason: Complete or deliberately skip Cazador before the Morphic Pool.
Complete or deliberately skip Viconia before the Morphic Pool.
Complete or deliberately skip Raphael before the Morphic Pool.
Complete or deliberately skip Ansur before the Morphic Pool.
Defeat Gortash and carry all three Netherstones before the Morphic Pool.

riskReward.risk: Permanently loses all remaining open-city access and camp services.
riskReward.skipCost: There is no safe skip; unresolved desired content becomes unavailable.
riskReward.returnBy: Before interacting with the Morphic Pool skiff.

title: Cross the Morphic Pool, Prism, and High Hall
summary: Sneak past or clear the intellect-devourer ambush, confront the brain, make the Prism transformation decision, apply endgame elixirs and Until Long Rest buffs after the forced rest, then use allies and mobility to conserve resources through High Hall.
avoid: Do not reach the brainstem without a valid illithid wielder of the Netherstones or without preserving final-battle resources.
why: This irreversible sequence determines who wields the stones and delivers the party to the final arena.

dependencies.reason: Complete the final lockout audit before using the Morphic Pool skiff.

decision.prompt: Who should wield the Netherstones as an illithid?

recommended.label: Choose the prepared ending route
costs: Every route has a companion or transformation consequence

alternatives.label: Free Orpheus
costs: Orpheus, Karlach, or the player must transform

title: Channel at the Crown and alternate damage on the Netherbrain
summary: Reach the Crown before the outer four-turn counter brings Nautiloid bombardment, protect Karsus' Compulsion until the caster's next turn, enter together, then kill the brain within the inner five-turn countdown while alternating damage palettes and leaving marked platforms.
avoid: Do not expose the channeler to Mind Flayer stun, enter the portal one character at a time, use every damage type before Aegis updates, or lose track of the inner five-turn hard limit.
why: Aegis of the Absolute makes the brain immune to every type used in the preceding round, so the final burst must be planned across rounds.
completionChecks: Final destroy or control choice recorded

dependencies.reason: Reach the brainstem with a valid Netherstone wielder before confronting the Netherbrain.

incident.trigger: The party enters the Crown portal and Aegis begins recording damage types.
safeActions: Trigger the first Brainquake with a durable entrant
Use one planned damage palette this round
Move from every Orb of Negation marker
incident.never: Spend all available damage types in one round and leave no legal damage for the next.
incident.escape: There is no retreat; preserve mobility and switch to the unused damage palette while platforms remain.
incident.honorDelta: Aegis of the Absolute is Honor-specific and grants immunity to the previous round's damage types; the inner fight still ends in defeat when its five-turn countdown expires.
